testing_progress.highlight: Bogota devnet-1 running but lightly stressed; spammer struggles with consistent Frame transaction throughput
RPC inconsistencies across clients blocking Frame transaction data retrieval; API specs not finalized
No clients have implemented tracing APIs yet; Explorer needs call traces (debug_traceBlockByHash) to inspect frames

eip_proposals_bogota.highlight: EIP-7999 max_fee PR (PR #12414): unified fee cap across execution/state/blob dimensions; broad conceptual support, Daniil raised fee-access opcode interaction concern still unresolved
PR #12502: bound arbitrary signature object length in canonical hash to prevent relay-padding cost attack; no opposition, plan to merge post-call
PR #12530 (7906): proposes removing TXDiff opcode in favor of TXTrace; deferred after Alex raised pre-state proxy slot use case not coverable by TXTrace alone

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: Spencer proposed adding to bogota-devnet-2: EIP-8131, EIP-8279, EIP-8253 (nonce bump), EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM), EIP-4758 (deactivate SELFDESTRUCT), EIP-8151; process/scope TBD at ACDT
Offchain Labs (Justin Zen) proposed VERIFY_NONSTATE + VERIFY_STATE frame modes to separate stateless signature verification from stateful checks, saving L2 sequencer re-verification

organizational.highlight: "nonce" preferred over "nonSequence" for Frame transaction field naming; 4+ clients aligned, Besu abstaining pending further thought
Next devnet remains Bogota devnet-2 (EL-only); combined Hegota devnet deferred; scope to be decided at Thursday ACDT before Mumbai travel

PR #12530 (remove TXDiff opcode) tabled pending resolution of pre-state proxy slot use case
